facts.name: BHP Group
sentences: BHP Group's shares moved 5% or more on 8 of the last 252 sessions.
The last move at least this big in the same direction was on 4 November 2026, when the stock rose 2.6%.
The stock is up 32.3% this year, and at $79.89 it sits 19.1% below its 52-week closing high of $98.69 from 25 August 2026.
$1,000 invested in BHP Group five years ago would be worth $1,613 today.
